responsibility: This file implements the RTL lower-subreg passes that decompose profitable multiword pseudo-register uses into word-sized pseudos and operations. It analyzes which wide pseudos are used only in decomposable contexts, estimates target-specific profitability for splitting moves, zero-extends, and doubleword shifts, rewrites SUBREG-based uses and defining insns into narrower operations, and repairs CFG/dataflow when newly split trapping loads alter block structure. It also defines the three RTL pass instances subreg1/subreg2/subreg3 that run at different points in the post-expand pipeline under flag_split_wide_types control.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/lower-subreg.h, which holds target-specific policy data for the transformation, this .cc file performs the actual RTL analysis and rewriting of multiword SUBREG uses and defines the subreg1/subreg2/subreg3 passes.
